term.label: SUMO_interaction_motif

definition.text: A polypeptide region that mediates binding to SUMO. The motif contains a hydrophobic core sequence consisting of three or four Ile, Leu, or Val residues plus one acidic or polar residue at position 2 or 3.

comments: Added as per request GitHub issue #434 (https://github.com/The-Sequence-Ontology/SO-Ontologies/issues/434)
